neighbours.label: a list of desirable qualities: the comma/'and' after a positive attribute, where another positive one (safe, reliable, healthy) is expected next; the + pole is the undesirable side
fire: The new bridge is strong, stable and built to last.
We want hospitals that are clean, safe and properly staffed.
Their software is fast, reliable and easy to maintain.
Children deserve homes that are warm, safe and stable.
The process should be simple, transparent and fair to all.
Our goal is a healthy, sustainable and affordable food supply.
The vaccine proved safe, effective and well tolerated.
Look for a bank that is secure, efficient and trustworthy.
quiet: The old bridge is weak, unstable and close to collapse.
We found hospitals that were dirty, unsafe and badly staffed.
Their software is slow, buggy and hard to maintain.
Too many homes are cold, damp and overcrowded.
The process was confusing, secretive and unfair to many.
The current food supply is unhealthy, wasteful and expensive.
The drug proved risky, ineffective and poorly tolerated.
Avoid any bank that is careless, slow and untrustworthy.

notes: Logit effect: + promotes incomplete/inaccurate/poorly, suppresses safe/healthy/reliable/secure; so - promotes the desirable side. Probe: positive lists 0.22-0.50, negative lists ~0.01.
